title: CODA: Rewriting Transformer Blocks as GEMM-Epilogue Programs
summary: CODA presents a novel approach to optimize Transformer block execution on GPUs by rewriting attention and feed-forward layers as GEMM-epilogue programs, treating the entire transformer computation as fused matrix operations rather than separate kernels.
problem_solved: Optimizes transformer inference and training efficiency by reducing kernel launch overhead and improving memory access patterns on GPU hardware.
why_valuable: Enables faster and more efficient LLM execution through low-level GPU kernel fusion, potentially reducing compute costs significantly for large-scale deployments.
